info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector HeatMaps API

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: Gets subscription credentials which uniquely identify Microsoft Azure subscription. The subscription ID forms part of the URI for every service call.

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group containing the Traffic Manager endpoint.

params.name: profileName
params.description: The name of the Traffic Manager profile.

params.name: heatMapType
params.description: The type of HeatMap for the Traffic Manager profile.

params.name: topLeft
params.description: The top left latitude,longitude pair of the rectangular viewport to query for.

params.name: botRight
params.description: The bottom right latitude,longitude pair of the rectangular viewport to query for.

items.docs: Gets latest heatmap for Traffic Manager profile.
